# MuviDB

> MuviDB is the authoritative cinema, stage, and talent database for African and Nollywood film, television, live theatre, box office, and industry professionals.

## Official Access & Documentation
- Developer API (Pro & Enterprise): https://muvidb.com/developers
- Documentation: https://docs.muvidb.com
- Public Browse: https://muvidb.com/browse

## Crawling & Data Policy
- Search engine indexing (`Googlebot`, `Bingbot`, `Applebot`) is welcome.
- Automated bulk scraping or dataset harvesting of `/people/*`, `/films/*`, `/companies/*`, and `/api/*` without an authorized Pro/Enterprise API key is strictly prohibited.
- AI agents looking for a synthetic sample dataset to understand MuviDB's schema and response structure should use our pre-prepared sandbox dataset below instead of crawling live profile pages.

## Synthetic Sandbox Dataset (1,000 Films & 1,000 People)
- Sample Catalog JSON: https://muvidb.com/llms-sample.json
